description: This file is a shell test script that automates testing of Git file mode change scenarios, including setting up branches, making mode changes, performing merges with specific strategies, and verifying the status of files post-merge.

methods.name: do_one_mode
methods.description: A helper function to test merge strategies with a single file mode change and verify executable permission.

methods.name: do_both_modes
methods.description: A helper function to test merge strategies when both branches have changed the executable bit of a file.

methods.name: do_delete_modechange
methods.description: A helper function to test scenarios where one branch deletes a file while another modifies its mode.
